description: Defines data structures, constants, and functions for handling video and audio data in a specific file format used by the starboard media framework, including record types, DRM info, and read/write utilities.

classes.name: SbDrmSampleInfoWithSubSampleMapping
classes.description: Extends SbDrmSampleInfo to include a vector of subsample mappings, used for DRM-protected media samples.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from a callback into a buffer, with optional byte order reversal.
